summary: A Waybar module that shows the free space of the root file system in gigabytes with one decimal, turns red when less than 10 gigabytes are free, refreshes every 60 seconds, and shows the used percentage in its tooltip.
targetUsers: Waybar users who want root file system free space visible in their status bar
goals: Show root file system free space in GB with one decimal in the Waybar label
Mark the label critical when free space is below 10 GB
Show the used percentage of the root file system in the tooltip
nonGoals: Monitoring file systems other than the root file system
Historical charts or trends of disk usage
Notifications or alerts beyond the label class
Detecting that a reading is only valid for one calendar day

features.name: Root free space label
features.userOutcome: The user sees the root file system free space in gigabytes with one decimal in the Waybar label and sees it turn red when less than 10 gigabytes are free.
features.trigger: The Waybar module command re-reads the cached label, and each refresh of the service loop or of the refresh action measures the root file system and writes the cache.
features.behavior: Each refresh reads the root file system free, used, and total space from the disk-space system source and writes the cache with the label text formatted as the free bytes scaled to GB with one decimal, rounded half away from zero, and class critical when free bytes are below 10000000000 and class normal otherwise. The module command with no action or --once never measures; it re-reads the cached label and renders it with the STALE_SUFFIX appended and class stale when the cache is marked stale. The tooltip shows the used percentage of the root file system, computed as used bytes divided by total bytes times 100, shown with one decimal and a percent sign. A reading reaches the bar at the next fragment re-run after the cache write.
features.failureOutcome: When the measurement fails, the cache keeps the last good label text with class stale, the module output rendered from that cache is that text with STALE_SUFFIX appended and class stale, and no stored record changes; when no reading was ever stored, the label is --.
acceptanceSignals: With 3,670,016,000 free bytes the label text is 3.67 GB with class normal.
With 9,999,999,999 free bytes the label text is 10.00 GB with class critical.
With 10,000,000,000 free bytes the label text is 10.00 GB with class normal.
With 500,000,000,000 total bytes and 100,000,000,000 used bytes the tooltip shows 20.0%.
After a failed refresh the module output rendered from the cache is the last good label text with STALE_SUFFIX appended and class stale.
With no stored reading the module output label is --.

dataObjects.name: Disk reading
dataObjects.purpose: Keeps the latest measured root file system free, used, and total space so the label and tooltip can be rendered.
dataObjects.retentionIntent: Only the latest reading is kept; each refresh replaces the single stored record.

qualityRequirements: The label shows free space with exactly one decimal in GB, rounded half away from zero.
The tooltip shows the used percentage with exactly one decimal.
The label class is critical when free bytes are below 10000000000 and normal otherwise.
productConstraints: The module reads only the root file system.
The label is composed from the cached reading; the module command never measures.
